verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents Radar, its own built-in 'Bot & Fraud Protection' product that 'protects your app from bots, fraud, and abuse,' with metered check-based pricing. The evidence explicitly covers bot protection only, and every source is a one-line marketing or pricing description. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of credential-stuffing and brute-force defenses (e.g., rate limiting, lockout, breached-password detection), detail on how Radar plugs into AuthKit sign-in flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
